elements.element: Preferred: no non-solicitation obligation binds Customer at all
elements.evidence: "Neither party shall directly solicit for employment the employees of the other party" — a mutual restriction still binds Customer

elements.element: Fallback: restriction is mutual (binds both parties)
elements.evidence: "Neither party shall directly solicit for employment the employees of the other party"

elements.element: Fallback: scope limited to personnel directly involved in the services
elements.evidence: "who are directly involved in the performance or receipt of the Services"

elements.element: Fallback: duration of 12 months running from the end of that involvement
elements.evidence: "during the period of such involvement and for twelve (12) months thereafter"
"making general solicitations for employment (including advertisements and searches by recruiting firms) not specifically directed at the other party's employees"
"or who approaches that party on an unsolicited basis"
restriction is on "solicit for employment" only; hiring expressly permitted — "or from hiring any person who responds"

elements.element: Fallback: period does not run independently for the full Agreement term
elements.evidence: "during the Term of this Agreement, for any reason" deleted; period tied to involvement

reasons: The locked fallback level is fully satisfied: the restriction is mutual, narrowed to personnel directly involved in the Services, expressly runs for twelve (12) months after that involvement ends, carves out general advertisements/recruiter searches and unsolicited approaches, and imposes no no-hire.

The two official checks reporting missing 12-month-from-involvement and unsolicited-approach language are pattern artefacts; the operative text states both expressly ("for twelve (12) months thereafter"; "approaches that party on an unsolicited basis").
The preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer) is not achieved, which is acceptable given the locked fallback target.

Word-count expansion is driven entirely by fallback elements absent from the original (scope limiter, duration trigger, two carve-outs, no-hire clarification); a single-operator or short-phrase edit could not supply them, so the rewrite of this one sentence is necessary rather than gratuitous.
No unrelated term is disturbed and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced; "Services" is used consistently with the agreement.
